title: Completion of a flat local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings is flat
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m_A)$ and $(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local rings and $\varphi:A\to B$ a flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] local homomorphism ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_A)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$). Let $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_nA/\mathfrak m_A^n$ and $B^\wedge=\varprojlim_nB/\mathfrak m_B^n$ be the adic completions [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] with canonical maps $\iota_A:A\to A^\wedge$, $\iota_B:B\to B^\wedge$, and let $\varphi^\wedge:A^\wedge\to B^\wedge$ be the ring map $(a_n\bmod\mathfrak m_A^n)_n\mapsto(\varphi(a_n)\bmod\mathfrak m_B^n)_n$ (well defined since $\varphi(\mathfrak m_A^n)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B^n$), so that $\varphi^\wedge\circ\iota_A=\iota_B\circ\varphi$. Then $\varphi^\wedge$ is flat. (Stacks states the equivalence: $\varphi^\wedge$ is flat if and only if $\varphi$ is flat; only this direction is stated here.)

source.place: Lemma Tag 0C4G (more-algebra-lemma-flat-completion, line 10731), the direction 'A -> B flat implies A^ -> B^ flat' (proof via algebra.tex lemma-flat-module-powers)

proof.text: The ring map $\iota_B:B\to B^\wedge$ is flat [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-completion-flat] ($B$ Noetherian, $I=\mathfrak m_B$). Since $\varphi$ is flat, the composite $\iota_B\circ\varphi:A\to B^\wedge$ is flat [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-comp]; i.e. $B^\wedge$ is a flat $A$-module via $\iota_B\circ\varphi=\varphi^\wedge\circ\iota_A$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 0C4G (lemma-flat-completion, line 10731), proof, second paragraph (lines 10752-10763): 'The vertical arrows are faithfully flat' (Algebra Lemma 00MC) and 'Then $A\to B^\wedge$ is flat' (Algebra Lemma 00HC)

proof.text: For each $n\ge1$ apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-quotient-flat] to the flat $A$-module $B^\wedge$ (step 1) and the ideal $J=\mathfrak m_A^n$: the module $B^\wedge/\mathfrak m_A^nB^\wedge$ is flat over $A/\mathfrak m_A^n$. Here $\mathfrak m_A^nB^\wedge$ is the ideal of $B^\wedge$ generated by $\iota_B\varphi(\mathfrak m_A^n)$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 0C4G (lemma-flat-completion, line 10731), proof, second paragraph (lines 10752-10763): 'Hence $B^\wedge/\mathfrak m_A^nB^\wedge$ is flat over $A/\mathfrak m_A^n$ for all $n\geq1$' (Algebra Lemma 00HI)

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-local-completion-local-ring] applied to $A$, $A^\wedge$ is a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_A^\wedge=\mathfrak m_AA^\wedge$ (generated by $\iota_A(\mathfrak m_A)$); hence $(\mathfrak m_A^\wedge)^n=\mathfrak m_A^nA^\wedge$, the ideal generated by $\iota_A(\mathfrak m_A^n)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-mod-power] ($\mathfrak m_A$ is finitely generated as $A$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]) the projection $\pi_n:A^\wedge\to A/\mathfrak m_A^n$ is surjective with kernel $\mathfrak m_A^nA^\wedge$ and $\pi_n\circ\iota_A$ is the quotient map; so $\iota_A$ induces a ring isomorphism $\bar\iota_n:A/\mathfrak m_A^n\xrightarrow{\sim}A^\wedge/(\mathfrak m_A^\wedge)^n$ (inverse induced by $\pi_n$).

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 0C4G (lemma-flat-completion, line 10731), proof, second paragraph (lines 10752-10763): 'Note that $\mathfrak m_A^nA^\wedge$ is the $n$th power of the maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_A^\wedge$ of $A^\wedge$ and $A/\mathfrak m_A^n=A^\wedge/(\mathfrak m_A^\wedge)^n$' (Algebra Lemmas 05GI, 05GG)

proof.text: Regard $B^\wedge$ as an $A^\wedge$-module via $\varphi^\wedge$. The ideal $(\mathfrak m_A^\wedge)^nB^\wedge$ of $B^\wedge$ is generated by $\varphi^\wedge(\mathfrak m_A^nA^\wedge)$, hence (as $\mathfrak m_A^nA^\wedge$ is generated by $\iota_A(\mathfrak m_A^n)$ and $\varphi^\wedge\circ\iota_A=\iota_B\circ\varphi$) by $\iota_B\varphi(\mathfrak m_A^n)$, i.e. it equals $\mathfrak m_A^nB^\wedge$. The $A^\wedge/(\mathfrak m_A^\wedge)^n$-module $B^\wedge/(\mathfrak m_A^\wedge)^nB^\wedge$ restricted along the ring isomorphism $\bar\iota_n$ of step 3 is the $A/\mathfrak m_A^n$-module $B^\wedge/\mathfrak m_A^nB^\wedge$ of step 2 (again by $\varphi^\wedge\circ\iota_A=\iota_B\circ\varphi$). Flatness is preserved under restriction along a ring isomorphism, so by step 2, $B^\wedge/(\mathfrak m_A^\wedge)^nB^\wedge$ is flat over $A^\wedge/(\mathfrak m_A^\wedge)^n$ for every $n\ge1$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 0C4G (lemma-flat-completion, line 10731), proof, second paragraph (lines 10752-10763)

proof.text: $A^\wedge$ and $B^\wedge$ are Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-noetherian]; $B^\wedge$ is a finitely generated module over itself; $B^\wedge$ is local with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_BB^\wedge$ [lem-weil-pbc-local-completion-local-ring], and $\mathfrak m_A^\wedge B^\wedge=\mathfrak m_AB^\wedge$ (generated by $\iota_B\varphi(\mathfrak m_A)$, as in step 4) is contained in $\mathfrak m_BB^\wedge$ since $\varphi(\mathfrak m_A)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$. With step 4, the hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-powers] hold for $R=A^\wedge$, $I=\mathfrak m_A^\wedge$, $S=B^\wedge$ (via $\varphi^\wedge$), $M=S$; its last clause gives that $B^\wedge$ is a flat $A^\wedge$-module, i.e. $\varphi^\wedge$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 0C4G (lemma-flat-completion, line 10731), proof, second paragraph (lines 10752-10763): 'Thus we see that $B^\wedge$ is flat over $A^\wedge$ by applying Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-flat-module-powers} (with $R=A^\wedge$, $I=\mathfrak m_A^\wedge$, $S=B^\wedge$, $M=S$)' (Algebra Lemma 0523; Noetherianity of completions Algebra Lemma 0316)

lean.statement: theorem flat_adicCompletion_of_flat_local (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : φ.Flat) (hlocal : ∀ x : A, x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A → φ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) : let mA : Ideal A := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A let mB : Ideal B := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B let Ahat := AdicCompletion mA A let Bhat := AdicCompletion mB B let ιA : A →+* Ahat := algebraMap A Ahat let ιB : B →+* Bhat := algebraMap B Bhat ∃ φhat : Ahat →+* Bhat, (∀ n : ℕ, ((AdicCompletion.evalₐ mB n).toRingHom).comp φhat = (Ideal.Quotient.lift (mA ^ n) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (mB ^ n)).comp φ) (by intro x hx change Ideal.Quotient.mk (mB ^ n) (φ x) = 0 rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] exact (pow_le_pow_left' ((Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).2 (by intro y hy exact hlocal y hy)) n) (by rw [← Ideal.map_pow] exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ hx)) ).comp (AdicCompletion.evalₐ mA n).toRingHom) ∧ φhat.comp ιA = ιB.comp φ ∧ φhat.Flat
